name: star2lte
title: Samsung Galaxy S9+ (SM-G965, Exynos 9810)
_note: Partition names verified from TWRP by-name listing (UFS, sda): BOOT=sda10, SYSTEM=sda18, CACHE=sda22, USERDATA=sda29, DTB=sda8, DTBO=sda9. No super partition.

userdata.name: USERDATA
userdata._note: Samsung formats /data as ext4, and a recovery wipe does the same: the fstab line has to match or /data is never mounted (HarmonyOS then runs without /data/log, /data/app, ...). Set this to f2fs only if you really format USERDATA as f2fs.

cache.name: CACHE
cache._note: 12 MB raw on this phone (7.6 MB as ext4): hmos-preinit keeps only the newest boot logs there.

_note_by_name: HarmonyOS ueventd only creates /dev/block/by-name/* when default_boot_device from /proc/cmdline matches the controller, and Samsung's bootloader filters our command line (the parameter never reaches /proc/cmdline). The per-controller by-name directory is created unconditionally, so the second-stage fstab points there.
cmdline_extra: buildvariant=user enforcing=0 hmos.permissive=1 hmos.noreboot=1 printk.devkmsg=on audit=0 firmware_class.path=/vendor/firmware
